requirements.requirement: The system must define a MongoDB collection named PublicHealthData.prescriptions.
The system must define a schema that requires an NPI field as a string with fixed length of 10 digits.
The system must define fields for drug identification including at least one of drug_name or drug_code.
The system must define a numeric field for total_claim_count that only accepts non-negative integers.
The system must define a field for derived_condition_taxonomy as a non-empty array of strings.
The system must enforce schema validation at the MongoDB collection level using JSON schema validation.
The system must align schema structure and validation patterns with Code/Schemas/ChatHealthy.Providers.json.
The system must define an ingestion contract that accepts documents conforming to the schema without transformation errors.
The system must successfully validate and accept a sample prescription document that includes all required fields.
The system must reject insertion of a document missing the NPI field.
The system must reject insertion of a document where total_claim_count is negative or non-numeric.
The system must reject insertion of a document where derived_condition_taxonomy is not an array.
The system must ensure compatibility with ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py for insert and validation operations.
The system must define indexing on NPI to support efficient query and aggregation operations.
